senses.gloss: शुतुद्री śutudrī, f. N. of a river in the Panjāb 🞄(RV.), later Śatadru, now Sutlej.
शूत्कार śūt-kāra, m. whistling, whizzing 🞄(etc.).
सुत् su-t, a. (—˚) pressing, extracting.
सुता sutā, f. daughter: -bhāva, m. daughterhood.
सूत 1. sū-ta, pp. of √ 1. 2. sū.
सुतपा suta-pā́, a. drinking Soma (RV.).
सुतावत् sutā́-vat, pp. act. having prepared 🞄Soma (RV.).
सुतष्ट sú-taṣṭa, pp. well-wrought (RV.).
सुतसोम sutá-soma, a. having the Soma 🞄prepared, offering a libation (RV.).

सुतार su-tāra, a. very bright;
 very loud.
सुतार्थिन् suta‿arthin, a. desiring a son.
सुतिन् sut-in, a. having a son or sons: -ī, f. 🞄mother of a son.

सुतीक्ष्ण su-tīkṣṇa, a. very sharp (also fig.): 🞄-m, ad. excessively;
 m. N. of a brother of 🞄Agastya.
सुतीभू sutī-bhū, become a son.

सुतुक su-túka, a. (RV.) swift, nimble;
 fugitive 🞄(foe).
सुत्य su-tya, a. n. (± ahan) day of Soma-pressing: 🞄ā́, f. solemn preparation of Soma (V.).

सुत्वन् sú-tvan, a. Soma-pressing (V.);
 m. 🞄N. (Br.).
सूत्थान su‿utthāna, a. very strenuous.
सूत्रयितव्य sūtray-itavya, fp. to be composed 🞄in the form of a Sūtra.
सूत्रात्मन् sūtra‿ātman, m. thread-soul, i. e. 🞄intellect conditioned by the aggregate and 🞄therefore passing through all things like a 🞄thread (ph.).
